title: High Striker
content: I have only my pencils with me, so I can't capture the noise, the motion, or the color of the midway at the county fair.I look instead for the bones of the scene—the canopy with its fiberglass decorations, and the fanciful lettering that says ROLLER MAGIC and TICKETS and PLAY LAND.On the far left is aHigh Strikergame waiting for a strongman with a mallet. The carnival worker taunts, "Which of you boys are real men?"A Popular Mechanics article in 1935showed how these games were sometimes fixed by controlling the tension of the wire leading up to the bell.
